name: Adversarial Machine Learning: Evasion, Poisoning and Model Extraction
description: An expert course on adversarial machine learning organized around the NIST AI 100-2 E2025 taxonomy: evasion attacks from FGSM and PGD to black-box and physical-world attacks, poisoning and backdoors, model extraction from prediction and LLM APIs, and defenses evaluated against adaptive attackers.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Adversarial Machine Learning: Evasion, Poisoning and Model Extraction

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
